name: imageio
description: Image files on disk: size, orientation and EXIF (date taken, camera, lens, exposure, GPS) from the header alone; thumbnails and downscaled pictures decoded off the program's thread, turned upright, newest request first, with an on-disk thumbnail cache. ImageIO on macOS and iOS (JPEG, PNG, HEIC, WebP, GIF, TIFF, RAW), stb_image, libwebp and TinyEXIF elsewhere
